# artie_encryption_key (Resource)

Artie Encryption Key resource. This resource manages encryption keys used for column-level encryption in pipelines. Keys can be passphrase-based (default) or KMS-backed. Reference a key's `uuid` from an `artie_pipeline`'s `encryption_key_uuid` to apply it to any table that has `columns_to_encrypt` set.

Encryption keys belong to the whole company, so this resource needs an API key with access to **All environments**: either full access, or the `encryption_keys:read`, `encryption_keys:write` and `encryption_keys:delete` scopes. An environment-bound key gets a 403. If your main key is bound to one environment, manage encryption keys through a second, aliased provider, as in the example below. Pipelines can keep using the environment-bound key to reference the key's `uuid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Encryption keys belong to the whole company, so manage them with a key that has access to All environments
# (full access, or the encryption_keys scopes).
provider "artie" {
  alias   = "workspace"
  api_key = var.artie_workspace_api_key
}

resource "artie_encryption_key" "pii" {
  provider    = artie.workspace
  name        = "PII"
  description = "Encrypts customer SSNs"
}

# Pipelines can stay on the default provider, even with an environment-bound key.
resource "artie_pipeline" "postgres_to_snowflake" {
  name               = "PostgreSQL to Snowflake"
  source_reader_uuid = artie_source_reader.postgres.uuid
  tables = {
    "public.customer" = {
      name               = "customer"
      schema             = "public"
      columns_to_encrypt = ["ssn"]
    }
  }
  encryption_key_uuid        = artie_encryption_key.pii.uuid
  destination_connector_uuid = artie_connector.snowflake.uuid
  destination_config = {
    database = "ANALYTICS"
    schema   = "PUBLIC"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the encryption key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the key's purpose.
- `kms_key_uuid` (String) UUID of an `artie_kms_key`. If omitted, a passphrase-type key is generated. Changing this forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key material (passphrase or encrypted DEK). This value is sensitive and will not be displayed in plan output.
- `type` (String) The type of the encryption key: `passphrase` or `kms`.
- `uuid` (String)
